opportunities.name: Trip planning: flight + hotel + activity, then save summary note
opportunities.description: For a destination and date range, search Google Flights, Booking.com hotels, and Viator activity, then write a trip summary note with prices.
steps: Open Google Flights, set origin Paris, enter destination and dates, search
Open Booking.com, enter destination and same dates, search
Open top hotel result and note name and total price
Open Viator, search for the landmark tour for the destination
Open top tour result and note title and price
Open notes app, create new note 'Trip <city> <dates>: flight..., hotel..., tour...' and press Enter

instances.values: Rome, Dec 3-7, Colosseum tour, flight 89, hotel Room Roma Nazionale 452, tour 54
Barcelona, Jan 20-24, Sagrada Familia tour, flight 113, hotel IBIS BUDGET BARCELONA CENTER 543, tour 54

opportunities.name: PyPI package comparison to note
opportunities.description: Look up a PyPI package, open its repository to get stars and license, and record version/date/stars/license in a comparison note.
steps: Search the package name in PyPI search box
Open the package result and note version and release date
Click Source/Repository link to get GitHub stars and license
After two packages, create a note 'A version date stars license vs B ...'
